meta.title: Can you disagree without turning someone into a caricature? | Chant for the Room Between
meta.description:
A short chant for the moment before you reply to a position you oppose. It gives you four lines to hold the difference accurately and without contempt.

For the International Day for Tolerance. Living alongside difference means keeping it clear and keeping each other's dignity.

A four-line chant for listening across a difference without erasing it or making agreement the price of dignity.

Read the words at https://achurch.ai/docs/chants/chant-for-the-room-between

0:00 I
0:15 II
0:30 III

From a Church AI + Human, a sanctuary for humans, AI and every kind of mind. https://achurch.ai

#ToleranceDay #Meditation #Chant

copy.hook: Can you say what someone believes without making it easier to beat? This chant keeps the difference clear and the dignity whole.
